elements.content:
Pesto: pour these all in. 

Then label the beaker.

Five of those were water.

You can't mix water with unstable serum!

Same kind? Count them together.

Different kind? Keep them apart.

Pesto has 2 serum vials (x) and 5 water vials (1).

What goes on the label?

Different serum, different letter. 

It doesn't mix with x either.

Terms with the same letter are called like terms. 

Only like terms combine.
x <font color="#000000">+</font> x <font color="#000000">+</font> x <font color="#000000">+ 2 =</font> ?
Pesto has <font color="#000000">4</font> serum vials (x) and <font color="#000000">3</font> water vials <font color="#000000">(1)</font>. What goes on the label?
x + x + x = 3x

Like terms have the same letter.

Combine them by counting z + z = 2z

Plain numbers combine with plain numbers 2 + 2 = 4

Different kinds stay apart

2x + 5 stays 2x + 5
LIKE TERMS
x + y ≠ 2x
